subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what storage, validation, auth, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The missing path is source-proven, but the implementation would define a new image-upload and workspace-write boundary that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated images under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves current read-only avatar-route protections.

options.title: Keep local override only
options.body: Keep Quick Settings browser-local overrides plus manual CLI/config/IDENTITY.md paths and avoid introducing a server-side upload surface.

options.title: Defer identity management
options.body: Leave this for a broader Control UI identity-management decision instead of adding a one-off upload RPC now.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated images under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves current read-only avatar-route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: The avatar support and safety history points to this owner as the best available decision route for the upload/security boundary.
